description: This Java source file defines the class HonoSaslAuthenticator, which implements a SASL authenticator supporting PLAIN and EXTERNAL mechanisms for client authentication within the Eclipse Hono project. It manages the process of initializing SASL, extracting client certificates, handling authentication requests, and attaching authenticated user information to the connection.

classes.name: HonoSaslAuthenticator
classes.description: Implements the ProtonSaslAuthenticator interface, providing SASL authentication with support for PLAIN and EXTERNAL mechanisms, handling TLS client certificates, and integrating with the AuthenticationService to authenticate clients.

methods.name: HonoSaslAuthenticator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the authenticator with a provided AuthenticationService.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the authenticator with the socket, proton connection, and transport; sets up SASL mechanisms and extracts client certificates if TLS is used.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs the authentication process, selecting mechanisms, and handling success or failure, updating the connection with authenticated user info on success.

methods.name: getSaslOutcomeForErrorStatus
methods.description: Maps HTTP-like error status codes to Proton SASL outcomes for authentication failure reporting.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Creates an authentication request, includes client certificate details if available, and delegates to the AuthenticationService to perform authentication.
